versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Few, enormous woodland knights on a board full of deliberate gaps: Duel at Start of Combat, Proud units standing alone, and one Champion fed by everyone.
Empty slots, sold squires and Duel wins all pay the Champion, so the order shrinks as its last knights grow grander.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wording pass on the rules that didn't read: Cork-Pop doubles limits too, Duels into an empty front row move to the back, Proud counts Created units, Gottfried's x4 is spelled out.
Refectory Prior now pays only from tier 3 so it stops being a free early buy; Hens reward Proud winners double and The Chronicler became optional.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wording fixes from the reviews: Hens are never Champion even under Dame Reisig, a sold Konrad pays whoever is Champion after he leaves, and The Chronicler gives twice the destroyed unit's stats.
Pennon-Squire now gives +2/+2 to a Proud target, so the thin Tier 2 card ties into the Proud build.
